sentences.en: I'd explain it to you, but your brain would explode.
sentences.zh: 我本来想给你解释清楚，但你的大脑会承受不住。

sentences.en: They could hear the sounds of shots and exploding shells.
sentences.zh: 他们能听到枪声和爆炸的炮弹声。

sentences.en: The bomb caused a lot of damage when it exploded.
sentences.zh: 炸弹爆炸时造成了很大的破坏。

senses.zh: 爆炸，爆发(感情)，激增，[计算机]，爆炸
